entities.name: Emich, 5th Prince of Leiningen

entities.summary: Emich, Prince of Leiningen was the son of Ernst, Prince of Leiningen. He was the fifth Prince of Leiningen from 1904 to 1918, and afterwards titular Prince of Leiningen from 1918 until his death.
